name: @treeseed/market
description: TreeSeed marketplace site built on top of @treeseed/core.

scripts.bootstrap: if test -f ./packages/core/scripts/treedx/workspaces/workspace-bootstrap.ts; then node --import tsx ./packages/core/scripts/treedx/workspaces/workspace-bootstrap.ts; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/treedx/workspaces/workspace-bootstrap.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/treedx/workspaces/workspace-bootstrap.js; else treeseed starlight:patch; fi
scripts.guarantee:capacity-local-acceptance: trsd reconcile test-live --mode acceptance --provider local --environment local --yes --json
scripts.check: npm run check:file-lengths && npm run check:ui-architecture && if test -f ./packages/sdk/scripts/verification/tenant-check.ts; then node --import tsx ./packages/sdk/scripts/verification/tenant-check.ts; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/verification/tenant-check.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/verification/tenant-check.js; else treeseed check; fi
scripts.build:web: npm run brand:sync && if test -f ./packages/sdk/scripts/build/tenant-build.ts; then TREESEED_LOCAL_DEV_MODE=cloudflare node --import tsx ./packages/sdk/scripts/build/tenant-build.ts; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/build/tenant-build.js; then TREESEED_LOCAL_DEV_MODE=cloudflare node ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/build/tenant-build.js; else TREESEED_LOCAL_DEV_MODE=cloudflare treeseed build; fi
scripts.preview: if test -f ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant/tenant-astro-command.ts; then node --import tsx ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant/tenant-astro-command.ts preview; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant/tenant-astro-command.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant/tenant-astro-command.js preview; else treeseed preview; fi
scripts.test:agent-ladder: npm -w packages/agent run build && npm run test:agent-contracts && npm run test:agent-handlers && npm run test:agent-message-chains && npm run test:provider-runtime
